ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity dark-grey/black pixels, approximately 0.25:1 across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation with light-grey mottling concentrated along the trailing edge and outer lobes. Distinct light-grey patches are mapped to the upper left quadrant and the far right tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 45 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations consisting of sharp, triangular pixel clusters along the entire trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve extending from the central notch to the pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized circular high-contrast white clusters detected on the far lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed primarily on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple linear rake marks across the fluke surface and barnacle attachment scars on the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge topography with deep serrated indentations.
